name: Form & Validation Experience
description: Form & Validation Experience standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-FORM applies.

rules.title: Validate at the appropriate layers
rules.detail: Client validation improves UX but backend/domain validation remains authoritative for security and business rules.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Validate at the appropriate layers.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Validate at the appropriate layers.

rules.title: Show field errors next to the affected control
rules.detail: Errors identify what is wrong and how to fix it; on submit, focus or navigate to the first actionable error when appropriate.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Show field errors next to the affected control.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Show field errors next to the affected control.

rules.title: Preserve user input after recoverable failures
rules.detail: Network/server validation failures should not erase valid entered values unless required for security.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Preserve user input after recoverable failures.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Preserve user input after recoverable failures.

rules.title: Model submitting and duplicate-submit states
rules.detail: Disable or guard duplicate actions while submitting and pair the UI guard with server idempotency where duplicate effects matter.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Model submitting and duplicate-submit states.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Model submitting and duplicate-submit states.

rules.title: Use correct input semantics and platform capabilities
rules.detail: Use appropriate input type, autocomplete, keyboard, mask and parsing without preventing paste or accessibility workflows.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use correct input semantics and platform capabilities.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use correct input semantics and platform capabilities.

rules.title: Distinguish required, optional and conditional fields
rules.detail: Requiredness and conditional visibility are clear before submission and validation stays consistent with current business state.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Distinguish required, optional and conditional fields.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Distinguish required, optional and conditional fields.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-FORM applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Form & Validation Experience to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Form & Validation Experience is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Form & Validation Experience failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
